comparison.objective: Discard rubbish while preserving a phone located among it; candidate performs controlled insert-tang removal.
comparison.physical_skill: Object classification and selective pick-and-place differ from impact tool manipulation, fracture, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Rubbish binned without binning the phone versus all four tangs fractured and contained without damage or loss.
comparison.reason: This is a semantic safety-selection task, not mechanical assembly finishing.
